# DrawingML frame preset

Original XML generated by `tools/frame_shape_fixture.py`, using the project's
original shape-defaults OPC shell. No corpus content is redistributed.
`native.pdf` was exported by the reference application and the source
was closed without saving. `tools/frame_shape_reference.py` records hashes and
256 independent native reference pixel samples across borders, holes and exterior regions.

Eight 200 × 90 pt shapes cover omitted adjustment (12500), 6745, 25000, 50000,
zero, -5000, 75000 and 10000. The first three contain text. The reference application clamps the
adjustment to [0,50000], bases uniform thickness on the shorter side, leaves
the opening transparent, and uses the opening as the text rectangle. These
observations agree with the ECMA-376 published `frame` preset definition;
no reference/spec divergence is claimed.

Browser regression checks these pixels before/after editing, export, reopening
and undo, and checks retained drawing XML and exact undo package contents.
The control uses no outline; it does not establish reference fidelity for every
compound outline, fill or rotated frame combination.
The inherited control typography still differs under browser font fallback;
pixel assertions avoid glyphs and establish frame geometry, not font fidelity.
